name: Scott Wiltshire
headline: Vice President & GM, Oracle NetSuite ANZ
about:
With over 25 years of experience in technology sales, I’ve built my career across both global enterprises and high-growth software companies, helping organisations transform through innovative business applications. For more than 15 years, I’ve led high-performing sales teams, united by a passion for solving complex business challenges and delivering lasting value for our customers and employees.

As General Manager for NetSuite in Australia and New Zealand, I’m privileged to lead a talented team dedicated to helping businesses scale smarter and operate more efficiently. We empower organisations to harness the power of the #1 AI Cloud ERP—AI that truly knows your business.

Used by more than 43,000 customers worldwide, NetSuite’s AI-powered business management suite connects data across ERP/Financials, CRM, ecommerce, and more. With a single source of truth, our AI doesn’t just guess—it knows.

NetSuite’s unified, cloud-based platform enables companies to streamline operations, gain real-time visibility, and make faster, data-driven decisions. Our mission is to help businesses across Australia and New Zealand grow with confidence, drive innovation, and do more with less in an increasingly AI-driven world.
